parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy+Playback` declared in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` — the `AnalyticsTesting` source directory and the `Mock` prefix are canonical mock-fixture markers. The high Jaccard similarity (0.875) between this mock proxy and the production `CPUSessionEvent` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift` is the *intended* relationship: the mock mirrors the production type so that analytics-testing infrastructure can substitute for it. Extracting shared shape into a common location would couple production `PlaybackCore` semantics to test/analytics-testing semantics, which the restraint rules explicitly prohibit. No refactor is warranted.
